g.text: return KafkaFuture.allOf(futures.values().toArray(new KafkaFuture[0])).thenApply(new KafkaFuture.BaseFunction<Void,Map<TopicPartition,ListOffsetsResultInfo>>(){@Override public Map<TopicPartition,ListOffsetsResultInfo>apply(Voidv){Map<TopicPartition,ListOffsetsResultInfo>offsets=new HashMap<>(futures.size());for (Map.Entry<TopicPartition,KafkaFuture<ListOffsetsResultInfo>>entry:futures.entrySet()){try {offsets.put(entry.getKey(),entry.getValue().get());}catch (InterruptedException|ExecutionExceptione){throw new RuntimeException(e);}}return offsets;}});
